description: Implement SageMaker, App Runner, and AWS Batch calculators with tests and docs. These are the final three calculators.
steps: Create src/pricing/calculators/SageMakerCalculator.ts implementing ResourceCostCalculator interface. supports() returns true for 'AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint' OR 'AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance'. For Endpoint: read resource.properties.EndpointConfigName (just metadata), use default ml.m5.large instance type. Use fallback pricing $0.269/hour. Monthly cost = 0.269 * 730. Return confidence:'medium'. For NotebookInstance: read resource.properties.InstanceType (default 'ml.t3.medium'). Query pricingClient.getPrice() for serviceCode 'AmazonSageMaker' with instanceType filter. Fallback: $0.0582/hour for ml.t3.medium. Monthly cost = hourlyRate * 730. Constructor takes optional customInstanceHoursPerMonth (default 730).

Create src/pricing/calculators/AppRunnerCalculator.ts implementing ResourceCostCalculator interface. supports() returns true for 'AWS::AppRunner::Service'. Read resource.properties.InstanceConfiguration.Cpu (default '1 vCPU') and resource.properties.InstanceConfiguration.Memory (default '2 GB'). Use fixed fallback pricing: vCPU cost = vcpuCount * 0.040 * 730 hours, memory cost = memoryGB * 0.007 * 730 hours. Parse CPU string: '1 vCPU' -> 1, '0.25 vCPU' -> 0.25. Parse Memory: '2 GB' -> 2. Also add $0.10 per million requests (default 1M/month). Constructor takes optional customRequestsPerMonth. Return confidence:'medium'.

Create src/pricing/calculators/BatchCalculator.ts implementing ResourceCostCalculator interface. supports() returns true for 'AWS::Batch::JobDefinition' OR 'AWS::Batch::ComputeEnvironment'. For ComputeEnvironment: read resource.properties.ComputeResources.Type (EC2 or FARGATE, default FARGATE). For FARGATE: use fallback pricing $0.04048/vCPU-hour + $0.004445/GB-hour. Default: 1 vCPU, 2 GB memory, 100 hours/month runtime. Monthly cost = (vCPU * 0.04048 + memGB * 0.004445) * hoursPerMonth. Constructor takes optional customHoursPerMonth. For EC2: return $0 with assumption 'EC2-based Batch uses underlying EC2 pricing - calculate via EC2 instances directly'. For JobDefinition: return $0 with assumption 'AWS Batch has no additional charge for job definitions - cost incurred on compute environments'. Return confidence:'medium' for Fargate.

Add tests in test/pricing/SageMakerCalculator.test.ts. Test: supports() for Endpoint and NotebookInstance; Endpoint cost calculation; NotebookInstance cost with mock API; fallback pricing; error handling.

Add tests in test/pricing/AppRunnerCalculator.test.ts. Test: supports() for AppRunner::Service; cost calculation with default CPU/memory; custom CPU/memory parsing; with custom requests; error handling.

Add tests in test/pricing/BatchCalculator.test.ts. Test: supports() for JobDefinition and ComputeEnvironment; Fargate ComputeEnvironment cost; EC2 ComputeEnvironment returns $0; JobDefinition returns $0; custom hours; error handling.
Register SageMakerCalculator, AppRunnerCalculator, BatchCalculator in PricingService.ts.
Add config entries in src/config/types.ts: sagemaker?: { hoursPerMonth?: number }, appRunner?: { requestsPerMonth?: number, hoursPerMonth?: number }, batch?: { hoursPerMonth?: number }.
Add documentation for SageMaker, App Runner, AWS Batch to docs/CALCULATORS.md.
acceptance_criteria: SageMakerCalculator.ts, AppRunnerCalculator.ts, BatchCalculator.ts exist in src/pricing/calculators/
docs/CALCULATORS.md updated with all three calculators
verification: Grep for SageMakerCalculator, AppRunnerCalculator, BatchCalculator in PricingService.ts
